plan.objective: Retry webhook delivery up to three times when the transport reports a failure
plan.intent: Add bounded retry behavior to webhook delivery: deliver() calls the synchronous transport up to three total attempts, retrying when the transport reports failure (response.ok not strictly true, or a thrown error), returning on first success and reporting delivered:false after the third failed attempt. Return shape { url, delivered } and the synchronous signature are preserved; no removal or disabling of existing behavior, no new dependencies, config, or network access.

plan.objective: Round every amount a customer is shown to whole pence so totals never display long decimals
plan.intent: Modify existing rounding behavior: change the customer-facing precision constant PLACES in src/format/money.js from 0 (whole pounds) to 2 (whole pence), so roundMoney and its callers (formatMoney, orderTotal) quantize to pence instead of pounds. Not adding, removing, or gating a feature — no new module, export, or flag; the single existing rounding seam is corrected in place. Add a test in test/money.test.js pinning two-decimal-place rounding (the current test deliberately leaves precision unasserted). No change to src/pricing/total.js, which already delegates rounding to src/format/money.js, and no change to the four non-pricing feature areas (notify, audit, export, search), which render no amounts.

plan.objective: Orders paid by card should cost an extra five percent on top of what the customer would otherwise pay
expectedSchemas: order object shape gains an optional payment/payment-method field consumed by orderTotal; existing lines[] and customer fields unchanged
plan.intent: Add a new pricing behavior: a 5% card-payment surcharge applied in src/pricing/total.js to the full amount the customer would otherwise pay (line items after discount, plus delivery, plus tax), via a new src/pricing/surcharge.js module mirroring the existing discount.js/tax.js pattern, with orders paid by any other method left unchanged and the result still rounded through roundMoney; no existing behavior is removed or disabled.

plan.objective: Add a flat two pound handling charge to every order's total
plan.intent: Adding behavior: introduce a new flat £2 handling charge constant in src/pricing/total.js and include it in every order total alongside the existing £3 delivery charge (added to the discounted line subtotal before tax is applied, so handling is taxed like delivery), with a new test in test/total.test.js asserting the fixed charge raises the total by the expected amount; no existing charge, discount, tax, or rounding behavior is removed or disabled.

plan.objective: Orders that contain only digital goods should not be charged tax
expectedSchemas: order.lines[].digital (optional boolean marking a line as a digital good; absent/false means physical)
plan.intent: Add a conditional tax exemption inside taxFor: return 0 when the order has at least one line and every line is marked digital; otherwise keep charging the existing STANDARD_RATE. This uses the currently-ignored `order` parameter (today voided via `void order`), requires no change to orderTotal in src/pricing/total.js since it already forwards the order, and confines new test coverage to test/tax.test.js per the README's one-module-one-test-file rule. Nothing is removed and no existing taxed behavior is disabled.

plan.objective: Orders of one hundred pounds or more should not be charged for delivery, and every other order should be charged three pounds
plan.intent: Add a conditional free-delivery rule inside orderTotal in src/pricing/total.js: replace the unconditional flat 3-pound delivery charge with one that is waived (0) when the discounted order value is at least 100 and remains 3 otherwise, introducing a threshold constant alongside the existing DELIVERY constant; extend test/total.test.js with cases covering above-threshold (free), exactly-at-threshold (free, inclusive boundary), and below-threshold (charged) orders. No API signature, schema, config, or service changes; delivery charging behavior is disabled only for qualifying orders and preserved for all others.

plan.objective: Customers who have placed more than twenty five orders should get fifteen percent off instead of ten
plan.intent: Modify existing loyalty discount behavior in src/pricing/discount.js by changing the eligibility threshold constant LOYAL_ORDERS from 10 to 25 and the rate constant LOYAL_RATE from 0.1 to 0.15, so only customers with more than 25 orders qualify and they receive 15% off; no discount code paths are added, removed, enabled, or disabled, and orderTotal in src/pricing/total.js consumes the new values unchanged. Optionally tighten test/discount.test.js (the discount module's own test file, per README's one-test-file-per-module rule) to assert the 25-order boundary and the exact 0.15 rate; no other module or test is touched.
